package rulefixtures

import "bytes"

// scenario for go_perf_layer_memory_allocation_bytes_buffer_allocated_per_record: Layer: Memory allocation. Flag bytes.Buffer construction per record when a reusable buffer can be reset safely.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
func scenario565Positive(records []string) []byte {
	var out []byte
	for _, record := range records {
		// A fresh bytes.Buffer is allocated for every record.
		// A single Buffer allocated before the loop and Reset()
		// between iterations would avoid per-record allocation.
		buf := new(bytes.Buffer)
		buf.WriteString(record)
		buf.WriteByte('\n')
		out = append(out, buf.Bytes()...)
	}
	return out
}
